description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.

WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.


About the Role

Financial advisors run their practices on a stack of platforms, including CRMs, financial planning tools, and portfolio and custodial systems. Zocks integrates with the tools advisors already use, and our integration partners reach the same advisors we do. When we market together, both sides grow faster.

The Principal Partner Marketing Manager owns co-marketing with our key integration partners. You will build joint value propositions, plan and run co-marketing programs, and launch new and expanded integrations to our shared advisor base, with the goal of driving pipeline and integration adoption. You will act as the marketing counterpart to each key partner, and work closely with our Partnerships, Product, Sales, and Product Marketing teams.

This role is suited to a senior individual contributor: someone equally comfortable building a joint go-to-market plan with a partner's marketing leader, writing the launch narrative for a new integration, and briefing our sales team on how to sell with a partner. Someone who’s not satisfied with a logo on a partner page and impatient to see co-marketing turn into pipeline.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the co-marketing strategy for our key integration partners, and prioritize partners and programs by pipeline and adoption impact.

  • Build joint positioning and messaging with each key integration partner that explains why Zocks and their platform work better together for advisors and their firms.

  • Lead joint launches for new and expanded integrations, from positioning and launch content through partner and sales enablement and advisor adoption.

  • Plan and run co-marketing programs with integration partners, including joint webinars, content, email and digital campaigns, events, and partner marketplace and app directory listings.

  • Build annual and quarterly joint marketing plans with each key partner, and manage shared goals, calendars, and co-marketing commitments.

  • Equip Sales and Partnerships teams to sell with integration partners, with partner playbooks, joint pitch content, and referral materials.

  • Drive adoption of integrations among existing customers, in partnership with Customer Success and Product.

  • Define and report on co-marketing metrics, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, integration adoption, and program performance.

  • Bring partner and customer insight to Product to inform integration priorities, and represent our integration partners in marketing planning.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline grows against the baseline you set in your first 90 days

  • Integration launches go out with a ready field, clear joint messaging, and measurable advisor adoption

  • Key integration partners see Zocks as a valued co-marketing partner, and joint programs run on a shared, repeatable plan

  • Sales and Partnerships teams know how to sell with each key integration partner, and use your playbooks to do it

  • More customers use Zocks with their integrated platforms, and Zocks is well positioned in each key partner's marketplace and channels

 

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 5 in partner, alliance, or co-marketing roles with technology and integration partners at a SaaS company.

  • Deep experience in financial services, ideally wealth management, advisor technology, broker-dealers, or another regulated industry.

  • A track record of running co-marketing programs with technology partners that measurably grew partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.

  • Experience launching integrations and technology partnerships, including the positioning, enablement, and adoption work that follows.

  • Strong relationship skills, with the ability to align marketing plans across organizations and influence partner marketing and executive teams.

  • Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to represent Zocks with partner leadership and at industry events.

  • A data-driven approach to joint program planning, partner attribution, and reporting.

  • A record of leading cross-functional launches and programs as an IC, through influence rather than authority.

  • Comfort operating in a growth-stage environment where processes and assets are still being built.

 

Logistics

  • This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, WA, WI

  • Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

 

Interview Process

  • 30-min recruiter screen

  • Up to three 30-45-min video interviews

  • Offer pending references.

Total estimated time: ~3 hours

 

Compensation

  • 190,000 - 210,000 base salary + equity

  • Equity - we're all building this together

BENEFITS

The full picture

Health

  • Medical: 100% of employee premium covered (UnitedHealthcare Select Plus network, 2 plan options)
  • Dental: 99% covered - Guardian, $1,500 annual benefit
  • Vision: 99% covered - Guardian/VSP, $150 frames & contacts allowance
  • FSA: Zocks matches dollar-for-dollar up to $500/year

Time off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid sick time
  • 12 paid holidays

Family

  • Birthing parent: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Non-birthing parent: 6 weeks fully paid parental leave

Financial

  • 401(k) via Guideline - Pre-tax and Roth options; low-cost Vanguard funds

Everything else

  • MacBook laptop + Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom provided
  • Equity grant - details included as part of your offer
  • Growth opportunities for high performers after 6 months
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with smart, kind teammates

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Zocks AI is an equal opportunity employer. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. We believe diversity drives creativity, innovation, and success - and we encourage all qualified people to apply.

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by humans.
